title: Titan X Strawberry Kiwi Watermelon Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Strawberry Kiwi Watermelon is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering a simple, mess-free way to enjoy long-lasting flavour. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. This vibrant fruit trio blends the soft sweetness of Strawberry with the bright tang of Kiwi and the fresh, mellow juiciness of Watermelon. Balanced and sun-soaked in character, this refreshing combination is enhanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Equipped with a pre-installed mesh coil for excellent flavour delivery and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works seamlessly with the Titan X’s smart auto-refill technology to provide up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
